title: be used to / get used to
en:
used to + verb = past habit (not now): I used to work in Almaty.

be used to + noun / -ing = it is normal for me, not strange: I'm used to working long hours. She isn't used to the cold.

get used to + noun / -ing = become used to something new: It took me a month to get used to the new system. You'll get used to getting up early.

After be / get used to — always -ing, not the infinitive.
ru: used to + глагол — раньше (сейчас нет). be used to + -ing / существительное — привык (для меня это нормально). get used to + -ing — привыкать (к новому). После be/get used to — всегда -ing.

boss.situation: Describe changes in your life or job: one sentence with used to, two with be used to and two with get used to.
samples: I used to work in a small office.
Now I'm used to working in a big team.
I'm not used to speaking English in meetings yet.
It took me a few months to get used to the new ERP system.
I'm sure I will get used to the new schedule.

qs.q: I ___ smoke, but I stopped five years ago.
It took me a while to ___ the new system.
qs.exp: Become used to → get used to.

qs.q: She isn't used to ___ in English.
“I am used to work late” is correct.
qs.exp: be used to + -ing: I am used to working late.

qs.q: “He used to live in Astana” means he lives there now.
Don't worry, you'll get used to ___ (drive) in the city.
I'm not used ___ the cold weather.
We ___ (use to) have meetings every day, but now it's once a week.
Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i am used to working long hours

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: she is getting used to the new job

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: we used to work in the same office

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I'm used to get up at six.”
a: I'm used to getting up at six.
I am used to getting up at six.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I am used to living in Almaty when I was a student.”
a: I used to live in Almaty when I was a student.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “You will soon get use to it.”
a: You will soon get used to it.
You'll soon get used to it.
I am used to working late.
I used to live in Almaty.

qs.q: Ты скоро привыкнешь к новой системе.
a: You will soon get used to the new system.
You'll soon get used to the new system.
You'll get used to the new system soon.
You will get used to the new system soon.
